manifesto.title: La Gemmerie
paragraphs: Here, gemmer once meant tapping a pine tree to collect its resin — a slow, precise skill passed down through generations in the Landes.
La Gemmerie carries that name, with another meaning too: the gemstone, rare and carefully shaped.
A home that brings both together — the artisan’s touch and a quiet sense of refinement.

spacesPreview.title: The 5 living spaces
spacesPreview.intro: A 150 m² Landes home, an independent 40 m² pool house and a heated pool from April to October — beautiful spaces that give everyone room of their own and make shared moments effortless.

spaces.title: The 5 living spaces
spaces.intro: Families who choose La Gemmerie often share one thing: several generations, different rhythms, one home. Every space is designed for being together — or taking a moment for yourself.
spaces.architectureNote: Exposed beams and terracotta tiles, wide glass doors opening onto the garden, a wood-burning stove for the quieter seasons — regional architecture respected, never recreated.

items.title: The pool house
items.description: Lunch in the shade of the timber frame, a bar overlooking the water — an independent 40 m² living space between house and garden, made for meals, naps and long evenings.

items.title: The pool and terrace
items.description: Heated to 27°C from April to October, the 4.5 × 12 m pool opens onto a pale timber deck with loungers and a century-old olive tree — the heart of the home, by day and after dark.

items.title: Living and kitchen
items.description: A fully equipped kitchen, wood-burning stove and generous communal table — the heart of the Landes house, designed for dinner for eight.

items.title: The lounge
items.description: A deep sofa and wood-burning stove, set apart from the kitchen — a more intimate corner for reading, unwinding or letting the evening linger.

items.title: The bedrooms
items.description: A principal suite, additional bedrooms and a children’s dormitory — each generation has a space of its own, without ever feeling far apart.

bathrooms.title: The bathrooms
bathrooms.intro: One en-suite shower room in bedroom 1, plus a shared family bathroom with bath and shower for the rest of the house.

labenneOcean.title: Labenne Ocean, between pine forest and sweeping sandy beach
labenneOcean.intro: Just 400 metres from the house lies a human-scale Landes seaside village — an immense beach, pine forest and activities for every generation, all without giving up the peace and quiet.

beach.title: Labenne Ocean’s central beach
beach.intro: Around 3 km of sand and a 180° ocean view from the promenade — Landes dunes to the north and, on a clear day, the first contours of the Basque Coast and Pyrenees to the south.

facts.title: Lifeguarded beach
facts.description: Patrolled from mid-June to mid-September — 11am–7pm in July and August, 12.30–6.30pm in late August and mid-September (2026 times).

facts.title: On the promenade
facts.description: Showers, toilets, food and drink, bicycle parking and a children’s playground.

activities.title: Things to do
activities.intro: Plenty to fill your days without driving far — most activities are only a few minutes away.

items.title: Surfing
items.description: Surf schools on the beach and SB3, one of Europe’s largest surf shops, right here.

items.title: Cycling
items.description: The Vélodyssée links dunes, pine forest and Capbreton harbour along a continuous cycle path.

items.title: Treetop adventure
items.description: One of Aquitaine’s largest forest adventure parks, just a few minutes away.

items.title: Water park
items.description: Aquatic Landes, in the forest — slides and pools for the whole family.

items.title: Nature
items.description: The Marais d’Orx reserve: 1,000 hectares, 247 bird species and a 6 km trail with hides.

items.title: Canoeing
items.description: A gentle trip along the Boudigau canal, setting off from Labenne.

items.title: Labenne Zoo
items.description: More than 200 animals, a few minutes from the house.

shop.title: The La Gemmerie collection
shop.intro: Inspired by the house, La Gemmerie is imagining a collection of thoughtful, enduring objects shaped by the materials, colours and crafts of the Landes.

collections.title: Home linens
collections.description: Beach towels and bath linens are being considered in the same spirit: beautiful textures, a distinctive palette and understated details.

collections.title: Candles
collections.description: A scent study built around pine, sun-warmed resin and evenings by the ocean.
